limit_rule: per target object and side, AC thresholds at training+validation exceedance [0.01, 0.001], rounded outward to 0.0025 p.u. or 0.0025 MW; locked after ac_only and before any fit
limit_rule_revision_v2: outward rounding is replaced by inward rounding when it leaves less than half the intended AC exceedance (branch reverse flow bounded by the clear-sky PV output); revised before any model error was read; v1 kept as limit_events_locked_v1.json
